k: Required by the Saudi Ministry of Health for every Umrah and Hajj pilgrim: a conjugate ACWY vaccine within the last {1} years (or polysaccharide within {2} years), given at least {3} days before arrival. The certificate should name the vaccine and the date — check the current MoH requirements.

Many Mina tents give each pilgrim only a narrow sofa-bed or thin mattress, and Muzdalifah is open ground — a roll mat and an inflatable pillow turn two nights into rest. Keep the whole Mina kit in one small bag you can carry yourself.

Your regular medicines for the whole {1}th–{2}th, rehydration salts, painkillers, blister plasters, a small first-aid kit, a power bank and cable — the camp is not the hotel; what you forget stays forgotten.

You will walk {1}+ km over the days of Mina: broken-in slip-on sandals with a strap. A cap is only for after the first tahallul — in ihram men keep the head uncovered and use an umbrella. A second ihram set is a mercy after Muzdalifah.
Cards are widely accepted, but keep cash for taxis, barbers and small shops.
Write it at the top of the Plan tab — the journey begins in the heart, not at the airport.
Write it at the top of the Plan tab — "the accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise" (Bukhari {1}). Decide now what you will ask for at Arafah.
Needed for Rawdah permits in Madinah and official services.
Two days before you fly, check the app will work in airplane mode: installed, saved for offline, fonts, prayer times through your return, the Arabic voice, hotel and companion saved, a recent backup.
Saudi Arabia requires at least six months of validity from arrival.
A small drawstring pouch for {1} chickpea-sized pebbles, and unscented wipes for freshening up in ihram (scented ones are forbidden in ihram).

Menstruation does not stop you entering ihram, making dua or doing sa'i after a valid tawaf — but tawaf itself must wait for purity. If your dates clash with a short trip, a doctor can advise; many sisters choose not to and simply wait.
Pass all seven levels in the Quiz tab ({1}%+ each). This ticks itself when the circuit is complete.
Pass all ten levels in the Quiz tab ({1}%+ each). This ticks itself when the circuit is complete.
Visiting the Rawdah in Masjid an-Nabawi requires a free timed permit — slots open only a short time ahead, so check Nusuk as your dates approach and book as soon as they open.
Men's ihram footwear should leave the ankle exposed. Shoes get lost at mosque entrances.
Bring more than you expect — the heat and travel can shift cycles. Available locally, but not always near the Haram.
Women end ihram by trimming a fingertip's length — there are no barbers for sisters, so carry your own. Pack them in checked luggage (hand-luggage rules vary by airline).

Strollers are not allowed on the ground floor of the mataf and can be turned away when the mataf or mas'a is crowded; pram tawaf is allowed on the upper floors and in the mas'a. A soft carrier is easier for tawaf and sa'i.
Labbayk Allahumma labbayk — see the Duas section in More.
Arrive with a clean heart — resolve to leave sins behind.
Midday courtyard marble is brutal — a light umbrella helps outside the mosque.
Perfumed products are prohibited in ihram — buy unscented before you travel.
Unscented — long tawaf and sa'i walks in ihram cause chafing.

Apply via the official Nusuk platform or an authorised agent — beware of unofficial sites. Since {M1} {1} a single-entry Umrah visa is cancelled if you have not entered Saudi Arabia within {2} days of issue, so don't apply too early — check the current rules on Nusuk.
Tawaf + sa'i is about {1} km on the ground floor, more upstairs; you may walk {2}–{3} km a day. Train before you go.

Mina→Arafah→Muzdalifah→Mina→the Jamarat→the Haram can mean {1} km or more on foot across two days in the heat. Build up to {2} km without stopping, in the sandals you will actually wear, and add stairs.
A sunnah of preparedness for any traveller.
Name, nationality, group, maktab number, a Saudi-reachable phone number and any medical condition — waterproof, on the wrist, from the moment you leave for Mina.
